answers.evidence: t001-t002 give the viewer-facing stake with a number: '你在台灣一定認得兩個山葉' / '二〇二五年台灣新掛牌的機車，有十二萬五千多台是山葉' (what the piano company's motorcycle turned into). Within six lines we are in a concrete moment: t003 '一九五五年七月十日，富士山的登山賽', t004 '前兩屆的冠軍，都是本田', t005 '起跑線上，有一款新來的小機車'. (Mild reservation: t002 is a present-day scale figure rather than an explicit 'what it changed' sentence.)

Chapter 1 stops before every result: the race outcome is withheld (t005 起跑線上... revealed only at t094 '二十九分零七秒，第一名'); t008 '一場戰爭，給這家鋼琴公司留下了一樣它沒想到的東西' does not say what it is (revealed t058); t009 '位置...已經很不一樣了' does not give the shareholding (t136/t137); t011 asks the question whose answer comes only at t144.

After the cold open at the 1955 race (t003-t007), the story runs forward in order: 1887 organ (t012) -> 1897/1900 (t028-t030) -> 1921/1939 propellers (t033-t042) -> 1944-45 war (t048-t060) -> 1953 order (t063) -> Feb 1955 shipment (t076) -> July 1955 spinoff and race (t088-t094) -> 1965-1996 (t110-t122) -> 2007-2026 (t124-t139). The opening moment is picked up, not retold (t092 '九天後，就是開頭那場富士山登山賽').
No section announcements or content lists. The only promise line is t010 '這份檔案，一百三十多年的帳，一頁一頁翻給你看', naming the subject with a scale, once.

Each chapter opener picks up what the previous chapter left: t012 '那台機車之前六十八年...' (the bike from ch1); t032 '那個客人，是日本陸軍' (answers t031 '一個你想不到的客人'); t050 '五月那場空襲...廠房全燒了' (t048-t049 air raid / what remains); t063 '社長川上源一下了一道極機密的命令' (the 社長 left with the headache and the machines question at t061-t062); t087 '他們不但沒停' (answers t086 '還敢繼續做嗎'); t102 '它帶走了' (answers t101); t124 '二〇〇七年，鋼琴那家還持有...股份' (picks up t123 '帳本上，寫的是另一回事').

Distant loops are named and paid: t008 'the thing the war left' -> t058 '還記得開頭說的那樣東西嗎？就是這批做螺旋槳的機器'; t006-t007 the odd seller -> t077 '開頭那件怪事就在這裡：型錄右下角印的公司名，是日本樂器'; t021 東京藝大 -> t079-t080; t005 race -> t093-t094 '起跑線上那台小機車...第一名'; t009 positions -> t136-t138 '百分之一點四六' / '還記得開頭說...就是這個'; t011 -> t143-t144 '不是同一家...營收是鋼琴那家的五倍多'. Adjacent ones answered directly (t016->t018-t019, t034->t035-t038, t040->t041-t042, t062->t064-t066, t078->t080, t086->t087, t097->t098, t101->t102, t113->t114, t135->t136, t142->t144).

Each number or fact is stated once; returns are explicit callbacks (t058 '還記得開頭說的那樣東西', t077 '開頭那件怪事', t079 '還記得東京藝大', t092 '開頭那場富士山登山賽', t138 '還記得開頭說', t143 '回到開場的問題'). t050 '五月那場空襲' points back to t048 and adds new facts. t091 '還不到本田的十分之一' is a new comparison, not a repeat of t071's 3,200.

All titles are events or reveals: '富士山的起跑線上，一台鋼琴公司賣的機車', '一八八七年，一台被打槍的風琴', '一九二一年，陸軍來訂螺旋槳', '一九四五年，燒掉的是做樂器的機器', '一九五三年，一道極機密的命令', '成立九天，就去爬富士山', '分了家，帶走音叉，也帶走手藝', '二〇〇七年以後，持股一路倒過來'. None is functional (background, conclusion, etc.).
Outro t145 '留言告訴我' and t146 '想一起翻檔案，就訂閱' mention no next video, episode or file.

Within 60 s: stake with a number to the viewer (t002 '十二萬五千多台是山葉'); a moment stopped before its result (t003-t007, the race start, no result); a promise line with scale (t010 '一百三十多年的帳'); a question (t011 '到底是不是同一家公司？'). Only two forward teasers (t008, t009), so not a clue list.

One thread: the piano Yamaha and the motorcycle Yamaha and whether they are the same company (t011), carried through every chapter: origin of the piano firm and tuning fork (ch2), woodworking taken up by the army (ch3), war leaves propeller machines (ch4), machines turned to motorcycles (ch5), motorcycle division spun off (ch6), what it took along and shared partners (ch7), shareholding reverses and answer (ch8, t141-t144).

Every segment feeds the piano-to-motorcycle relationship: the organ/Geidai/tuning-fork episode sets up later payoffs (t021->t080, t027->t102-t108); propellers and the war explain the machines (t058, t066); the Toyota steering wheel (t110-t112) and 功學社 piano lessons (t115-t117) show what was shared across the split; the 2015 design show (t129-t130) sets up the share question (t131). No product, score or quote lists; the race result is two lines (t094-t095).
